# Len

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Strings](Language-Features-Strings)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Len:Int32 string:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text to measure. |

**Returns:** How many characters a string has. An empty string has 0.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Len("hello")
```

```text
5
```
